records.observation: FileInputStream open failure logs FileNotFoundException then exits0 (success code). Wraps BufferedInputStream1024 and DataInputStream, constructs Preamble, ignores read boolean. Checks exact version then compatibility, incompatible exits1/compatible warns; rejects little endian exit1, no conversion. Does not check finalized, number of blocks or communicator table pointer. Null version after failed preamble can throw; late parse failure with accepted version/endian can pass while LineID global setup did not occur. getBlockStream lazily allocates one byte array from unchecked preamble block size, readFully fills it, EOFException silently returns null (including truncated final block), other IOException logs/null. Successful calls create new MixedDataInputStream over ByteArrayInputStream sharing reusable buffer; retaining older stream across next call exposes overwritten data. Zero-size block returns empty stream without consuming input; negative size allocation fails. Standard consumption switches block at type1; null then becomes content exhaustion and wrapper proceeds to map/output completion without distinguishing truncated block EOF. get undefined definitions delegates preamble start/count to RecDefState/Event factories. close catches IOException only and does not clear stream; finalize calls close and superclass finalize even on error. No finally covering constructor exits. No archived execution.

records.observation: Subclass of DataInputStream without overrides for numeric reads, readFully or skipBytes: inherited behavior, no endian conversion. Only readString(n): allocate n bytes, readFully, decode platform-default charset, find first U+0000; returns substring before NUL trimmed only when index>0, otherwise null (first NUL, absent NUL or empty length). Negative n fails allocation. Unlike base.io mixed stream this is fixed-size text field reading; no explicit charset, terminator validation error or fallback.

records.observation: Reads fixed1024 bytes fully; IOException log/false before parsing. Default charset String and NUL StringTokenizer (empty tokens skipped), positional trimmed tokens: version; title/value pairs endian, finalized, block size, block count, world size, thread count, known/user event starts, known/user solo starts, known/user state counts, known/user solo counts; final title and three long values produce communicator pointer=a*b+c. Titles stored/displayed, never matched expected labels; extra tokens ignored. Boolean true for case-insensitive true/yes only, all other strings false. Integer/long values unrestricted; arithmetic overflow unchecked. NoSuchElementException/NumberFormatException log/false after partial assignments. Only complete parse invokes shared LineID.setCommRank2LineIDxForm(world,threads), then true; failures preserve prior global configuration. Exact version case-insensitive CLOG-02.44, compatibility loops Const.COMPAT_VERSIONS until match; Const values separately unread. Null version unguarded. Getters directly expose parsed values (no block-count getter here), toString prints all stored titles/values. InputLog ignores false, does not enforce finalized/positive sizes or record-count consistency, so parsing partial-state failure can survive its version/endian checks.
